summary: CPP-vs-TS Prompt/Input Widget full-dimension audit. 45 findings: P0-BLOCKER=3 (enum fragmentation, prefix glyph split, placeholder cascade missing), P1-VISIBLE=12 (vim impl conflict, 5 autocomplete sources absent, paste truncation, bash prefix leak, etc.), P2-MINOR=20, P3-INFO=3, ALIGNED=7.

gaps.ts_impl_summary: PromptInputMode is a 2-value union {'prompt'|'bash'}, driven solely by leading '!' prefix. getModeFromInput/getValueFromInput/prependModeCharacterToInput all wrap the '!' char.
gaps.cpp_impl_summary: Three mutually-incompatible PromptInputMode enum fragments: (1) prompt_input_full.cppm has 8 values {Normal,HistorySearch,SlashCommand,PlanMode,FastMode,VimNormal,VimInsert,VimVisual}; (2) text_input.cppm PromptMode has 7 values {Normal,Bash,Command,FileRef,Agent,Search,BgRun}; (3) prompt_input_footer.cppm has 5 values {Prompt,Bash,SlashCommand,HistorySearch,PlanMode}. None matches the TS 2-value {prompt/bash}; no unified '!' prefix gatekeeper.
gaps.evidence: TS inputModes.ts line 16-21 only checks startsWith('!'); CPP has three enums across three modules with no shared include.
gaps.notes: Before M1+M2 faithful port: (a) establish single authoritative cc::ui::prompt::InputMode={Prompt,Bash}; (b) delete the two stray enums; (c) derive mode solely from '!' prefix inside TextInputImpl.

gaps.ts_impl_summary: 3-way render: (1) non-bash + no teammate = ❯ default; (2) non-bash + teammate = ❯ with AGENT_COLOR_TO_THEME_COLOR[color]; (3) bash = '!' in bashBorder color + trailing nbsp. isLoading applies dimColor.
gaps.cpp_impl_summary: Three competing prefix systems: (1) mode_indicator.cppm renders ● NORMAL / ◆ PLAN / ▶ VIM / ◎ SEARCH badge pills with raw ANSI - completely different glyph set; (2) prompt_input_full.cppm prepends inline ANSI colored badges e.g. '[PLAN]', '[FAST]', '[N]/[I]/[V]'; (3) text_input.cppm uses a generic '▶ ' hardcoded prefix with Color::Green. No module renders ❯ + bash '!' as the TS source.
gaps.evidence: TS PromptInputModeIndicator.tsx lines 79-88 only emit figures.pointer (❯) or '!'; CPP never emits either glyph as prompt prefix.
gaps.notes: Delete mode_indicator.cppm as obsolete. Add a single render_prompt_prefix() in a new ui/prompt/prefix_glyph.cppm that emits ❯ or '!' + teammate color + loading dim.

gaps.ts_impl_summary: 4-tier cascade with guards: (1) viewingAgentName -> 'Message @{name}...' with 20-char truncation; (2) editable queued cmds + hintCount<3 -> 'Press up to edit queued messages'; (3) submitCount<1 + suggestionsEnabled + !proactive -> getExampleCommandFromCache(); (4) undefined/empty otherwise. useMemo on [input,queuedCmds,submitCount,...].
gaps.cpp_impl_summary: Single static string field TextInputOptions.placeholder = 'Type your message here...'. No teammate-name gate, no queued-command hint counter, no example-command cache integration.
gaps.evidence: usePromptInputPlaceholder.ts lines 32-66 implement 4-tier memoized cascade; CPP TextInputOptions.placeholder is a plain std::string.
gaps.notes: Needs engine wire: viewingAgentName from swarm state, queued command editable count from command queue, submitCount from session, exampleCommandCache provider.

gaps.ts_impl_summary: Single wrapper around BaseTextInput via useVimInput hook; one VimMode enum {Normal,Insert,Visual,None}. invert function passed through via chalk.inverse when focused. No standalone vim status bar; mode badge is '-- INSERT --' inline in FooterLeftSide.
gaps.cpp_impl_summary: Three competing vim layers: (1) vim_input.cppm VimInput component with own state, 6-mode enum {Normal,Insert,Visual,VisualLine,Command,Replace}, renders its own colored status bar + badge at bottom; (2) text_input.cppm TextInputImpl has no vim integration (enable_vim field unused); (3) prompt_input.cppm VimHandler with 3-mode enum + character-level process_key() that only handles single chars (no Escape).
gaps.evidence: vim_input.cppm VimMode enum has 6 values; prompt_input.cppm VimHandler has 3 values; text_input.cppm enable_vim bool is never read in HandleEvent.
gaps.notes: Keep vim_input.cppm as authoritative, delete prompt_input.cppm VimHandler, wire vim_input into text_input via a decorator pattern, remove the duplicate status bar render.

gaps.ts_impl_summary: Permission mode is cycled via shift+tab at footer level; modes = {default, AcceptEdits, AcceptAll, Plan}; each has symbol + title + theme color; hint '(shift+tab to cycle)' shown when primaryItemCount<2.
gaps.cpp_impl_summary: prompt_input_footer.cppm implements symbol/title/color helpers and even renders the '(shift+tab to cycle)' hint text, but text_input.cppm HandleEvent does NOT bind TabReverse/shift-tab to any cycle action. PermissionMode enum inside text_input.cppm also differs (6 values including UltraPlan/UltraReview).
gaps.evidence: Footer RenderModeIndicator line 197-198 renders the hint; text_input.cppm HandleEvent TabReverse at line 620-624 cycles history, not permission.
gaps.notes: Move PermissionMode enum into footer module (4 values matching TS), bind shift-tab at repl_screen level to cycle engine state, not inside TextInputImpl.

gaps.ts_impl_summary: combinedHighlights array with 8 priority tiers: imageRef > btw > slashCommandTrigger > tokenBudget > memberMention > rainbowShimmer(ultrathink/ultraplan/ultrareview/buddy) > voiceInterimDim > default. Each generates spans with theme-colored fg/bg.
